cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort the birthday invitations. Address verification failed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll correct the archive together. Can you read me the current address?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the archive. Tell people you sent them to the wrong house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write 'Replacement invitation: address verification failure.' You check the address before I send them.

reason: A now directs actual correction and offers B the checking role; the replacement wording still hides personal agency instead of summarizing a staffing theme.
